windows.command: $ans = Read-Host 'Do you want to upload after build? [Y/N]'; if ($ans -match '^[Yy]') { & '${env:USERPROFILE}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe' run --environment ${input:pioEnv} -t compiledb -t upload } else { & '${env:USERPROFILE}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe' run -t compiledb --environment ${input:pioEnv}; Write-Host 'Upload skipped' }

linux.command: read -p 'Do you want to upload after build? [Y/N] ' ans; if [[ $ans =~ ^[Yy] ]]; then "$HOME/.platformio/penv/bin/platformio" run --environment ${input:pioEnv} -t compiledb -t upload; else "$HOME/.platformio/penv/bin/platformio" run -t compiledb --environment ${input:pioEnv}; echo 'Upload skipped'; fi
